title: Change and share your booking link
summary: Choose a readable unique link while preserving previously used business links.

sections.title: Edit the booking link
sections.body:
1. Open **Business setup → Business profile → Identity & contact**.
2. Review **Booking link**. Enter a short, readable business name using the permitted letters, numbers and hyphens.
3. Select **Save business profile**. If the name is unavailable or reserved, choose another name.
4. In **Online booking**, use **Copy booking link** after the page is live. Share that complete link on your website or business materials.

sections.title: What happens to old links
sections.body: Previously owned business links redirect to your current primary link. Changing the link does not transfer another business’s address to you. A link is not public booking permission by itself: publication and online availability still apply.

sections.title: If the link does not accept bookings
sections.body: Check the **Live** state and **Accept online bookings**, then check service and staff eligibility. Share the complete business booking link, never a client’s private appointment-management link. If a validation message says the name is taken, changing capitalization does not make it a different available name.
